sourceFacts: Exact wrapper props/slots/native output from sources/react-api-inventory.json and pinned code.
contentAlternative: The nonempty visible label text names the actual native control through for/id; placeholders do not replace it.
updatesAndDescendants: Label is a native label wrapper. Pointer activation delegates native focus to its associated control, while keyboard navigation targets the control itself. Text/for changes rerender normally; disabled appearance is styling, not a separate disabled label API.
referenceDecision: The reference chooses one explicit for/id relationship. A real native input must own that ID; custom controls use the corresponding primitive label integration.
keyboard: This default content wrapper does not install a keyboard listener or roving focus. Native links/buttons/inputs in the chosen children retain their own documented semantics. Label delegates native focus through its associated control.
naming: The HTML projection identifies all required visible content/labels. No unnecessary ARIA role/name is imposed on native text, headings, kbd or tables.

label.description: Native label; caller supplies htmlFor/target ID.

field.description: Optional caller-owned field arrangement and disabled presentation context.
